messages:
leo: Quiet window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Small coordinated deploy across api/runtime/console/router. Need owners and rollback snippets here.

deploy-bot: Window scheduled 22:00 UTC. Runbooks RB-421 & RB-422 linked. Ack with ownership.

maria: I'll do router header-split + shadowing. Plan: shadow 10m -> 1% -> 5% -> 20%. Revert if routing mismatch >0.5% or 5xx spike.

devin: Runtime owner. Pin rwinference:2.4.0-rc and start at 3% canary. Watch KV-miss and GPU OOMs. Rollback if KV miss +20% or p95 >2s for 5m.

leo: API owner?

maria: julie usually, but julie is OOO. I can flip header but need API flag ownership.

devin: I'll coordinate with API via the console gate. For API we plan a feature-flagged schema change scoped to canary. Console will keep backcompat on.

ops-oncall: I'll create #ephemeral/deploy-1765552468, hook p95/5xx/KV-miss alerts and page on thresholds. 15min watch after full.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: images present, infra checks green, console build available.

maria: Router rollback: `rtrctl set --route header-split --version v0.9.2 --reason "rollback by maria"`

devin: Runtime rollback: `deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-image rwinference:2.3.8 --immediate`

leo: All acked. We'll start at 22:05 UTC to allow final staging. If rollback called, ping @ops-oncall + @deploy-bot and mark incident. Thanks.
